constructor.details: The emissions contract exists already, so it is a constructor argument and immutable: no wiring step on      this side, and nothing an owner key could repoint. openPlanting().details: Refuses to open an unwired registry (compatibility review, 2026-09-17): a plot planted while the emissions      listen elsewhere would carry no weight, and one planted while the plot contract's hook points elsewhere      would stay planted through a sale. Both wires are read, not assumed.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

plant(uint256).details: CEI + nonReentrant (audit M6 on the first registry): the activation write lands before the token calls;      the trailing sync is permissionless and idempotent.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

MAX_BATCH.details: Bounds a batch's gas (each plot is a storage write, an event and an emissions sync). The site chunks above it.

BagSpent(uint256).notice: This plot has been planted before: its one bag is spent, or was never taken. It plants with $CROP.

NotWired().notice: The emissions or the plot contract listen to another registry: `openPlanting` before the switch, or         any door after a rollback.

bagAvailable(uint256).notice: Can this plot take its one seed bag right now? (planting open, door open, a funded bag left, never         planted, dormant)

bagOpen().notice: The owner's emergency switch on the ETH door alone. The $CROP door has none, as before.

bagPrice().notice: The first registry's getter, kept so every reader of `bagPrice()` works unchanged. Always BAG_PRICE.

bagsLeft().notice: Bags a buyer can still get: the cap, or fewer if the treasury's allowance or balance pays for fewer         (security review, 2026-09-17: a view must not say yes to a bag the token would refuse). `bagsSold` is the         cap's own counter.

everPlanted(uint256).notice: True from a plot's first planting, by either door, for ever. The seed bag asks for false.

openPlanting().notice: Opens both doors for good. There is no way to close planting again.

plantMany(uint256[]).notice: Every plot of the batch, or none: one plot that is not the caller's, or already planted, reverts all.

plantWithBags(uint256[]).notice: Every plot of the batch, or none: the payment must be exactly `BAG_PRICE` times the batch, and one plot         that has been planted before, is planted now, or is not the caller's reverts all.

plantingOpen().notice: False until the owner opens planting; never false again.

    /**
     * @dev Returns the account approved for `tokenId` token.

    function getApproved(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address operator);

     * @dev Returns if the `operator` is allowed to manage all of the assets of `owner`.
     *

    function isApprovedForAll(address owner, address operator) external view returns (bool);

NotWired().notice: The emissions or the plot contract listen to another registry: `openPlanting` before the switch, or         any door after a rollback.

BagSpent(uint256).notice: This plot has been planted before: its one bag is spent, or was never taken. It plants with $CROP.

userdoc.notice: Planting registry, second edition (owner's scope, 2026-09-17): the same two doors as NativeActivation, with         the seed bag's rules moved out of policy and into code.           - A plot gets ONE seed bag in its life, and only for its very first planting: `everPlanted` survives every             transfer, where `since` does not. A plot that has been in the ground before, by either door, plants with             $CROP from then on, whoever holds it.           - Only 3,333 bags exist (`MAX_BAGS`), one for each plot of the collection.           - A bag costs 0.001 ETH (`BAG_PRICE`). A constant: nobody can set another price, and no keeper moves it.           - Nothing can be planted before the owner opens planting, once and for good (`openPlanting`): everyone             starts on the same announced minute. Planting before Genesis is wanted ("pre-planting"): emissions pay             nothing before HarvestEmissions.start whatever is in the ground.           - `plantMany` and `plantWithBags` plant a whole holding in one transaction, all or nothing.         Everything else is NativeActivation's, line for line: 2,500 $CROP with 60% burned and 40% to the treasury;         a bag burns 1,500 of the treasury's own $CROP and forwards the ETH to the treasury; the plot NFT stays in the         wallet; a transfer clears the planting through the NFT's hook; the contract never holds ETH or $CROP. The         single-plot functions, the views, the events and the errors keep their names and shapes, so the site, the API         and the bot read this contract exactly as they read the first one.         It becomes the farm's planting registry by `HarvestEmissions.setActivationSource` and         `YieldFarmNFT.setTransferHook`, both the owner's and both reversible. On an EMPTY farm pointing them back at         the first registry is the whole rollback. Once plots are planted here it is an emergency only (interplay         review, 2026-09-17): their weight stays until each is synced and then reads zero, and the fees and the bags         stay spent (`everPlanted` and `bagsSold` are for ever). Every door reads the two wires on every call         (security review, 2026-09-17): a rolled-back registry refuses to plant (`NotWired`) instead of taking         2,500 $CROP, or 0.001 ETH and the treasury's 1,500 $CROP, for no weight, and spending a bag for ever.

bagOpen().notice: The owner's emergency switch on the ETH door alone. The $CROP door has none, as before.

bagPrice().notice: The first registry's getter, kept so every reader of `bagPrice()` works unchanged. Always BAG_PRICE.

bagsLeft().notice: Bags a buyer can still get: the cap, or fewer if the treasury's allowance or balance pays for fewer         (security review, 2026-09-17: a view must not say yes to a bag the token would refuse). `bagsSold` is the         cap's own counter.

openPlanting().notice: Opens both doors for good. There is no way to close planting again.

plantingOpen().notice: False until the owner opens planting; never false again.

everPlanted(uint256).notice: True from a plot's first planting, by either door, for ever. The seed bag asks for false.

plantMany(uint256[]).notice: Every plot of the batch, or none: one plot that is not the caller's, or already planted, reverts all.

bagAvailable(uint256).notice: Can this plot take its one seed bag right now? (planting open, door open, a funded bag left, never         planted, dormant)

plantWithBags(uint256[]).notice: Every plot of the batch, or none: the payment must be exactly `BAG_PRICE` times the batch, and one plot         that has been planted before, is planted now, or is not the caller's reverts all.

RenounceDisabled().details: Renounce is disabled like on every owned contract of the farm (audit 2026-09-02 T-2): a renounce before      `openPlanting` would close planting for ever.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

constructor.details: The emissions contract exists already, so it is a constructor argument and immutable: no wiring step on      this side, and nothing an owner key could repoint. Codeless targets are refused for the reason      NativeActivation.setEmissions gave: every `sync` would revert uncaught.

openPlanting().details: Refuses to open an unwired registry (compatibility review, 2026-09-17): a plot planted while the emissions      listen elsewhere would carry no weight, and one planted while the plot contract's hook points elsewhere      would stay planted through a sale. Both wires are read, not assumed.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

plant(uint256).details: CEI + nonReentrant (audit M6 on the first registry): the activation write lands before the token calls;      the trailing sync is permissionless and idempotent.

acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

afterTransfer(address,address,uint256).details: NativeActivation's hook, unchanged: clear first, then resync in try/catch with a saturating gas budget, so      the catch can always emit `SyncFailed` and the hook never reverts after the clear. `everPlanted` is NOT      cleared: that is the whole point of this edition.

MAX_BATCH.details: Bounds a batch's gas (each plot is a storage write, an event and an emissions sync). The site chunks above it.
